```{r}
library(tensormodels)
library(tidyverse)
```


## Poisson Sim for EM

The mean of $x_{1}$ is $\lambda_{1}$ and the mean of $y_{1}$ is $\beta * \lambda_{1}$.
```{r}
n <- 20

lambdas <- 30 * runif(n = 20)
beta <- 0.2

x <- rpois(n = n, lambda = lambdas)
y <- rpois(n = n, lambda = beta * lambdas)

beta_hat <- sum(y)/sum(x)

lambdas_hat <- (x + y)/(beta_hat + 1)

sum(lambdas_hat - lambdas)
```


## Normal Mean-Variance Mixture with $U \sim Unif(0, 1)$

```{r}
mean_mix <- function(n, mu = 0, sigmas = list(matrix(1)), skew = 1, nu = 4) {
  dims <- dim(mu)
  
  if(is.null(dims)) dims <- length(mu)

  # draw tensor variate normals
  tensor_norms <- rtnorm(n, mu = array(0, dim = dims), sigmas)

  # generate inv gamma
  unif_draws <- runif(n = n)
  #inv_gammas <- rinvgamma(n = n, shape = nu/2, rate = nu/2)

  mix_unif_draws <- vector("list", n)

  for(i in 1:n) { # scale normals and skew by inv gamma
    mix_unif_draws[[i]] <- mu + tensor_norms[[i]] * sqrt(unif_draws[i]) +
                        skew * unif_draws[i]
  }

  mix_unif_draws
}
```


```{r}
s1 <- matrix(c(1, 0.25, 0.25, 0.5), nrow = 2)

n <- 1e3

mix_unif_noskew <- mean_mix(n = n, mu = c(1, 2), 
                            sigmas = list(s1), skew = c(0, 0))

pull_draw <- function(i, data) {
  curr_draw <- data[[i]]
  tibble(val = c(curr_draw[1], curr_draw[2]), 
         pos = c(1, 2), draw = c(i, i))
}

noskew_draws_pos <- map_dfr(.x = 1:n, .f = pull_draw, 
                            data = mix_unif_noskew)

noskew_draws_pos |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = val), color = "black", fill = "lightpink") +
  facet_wrap(~pos, nrow = 2) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
mix_unif_skew <- mean_mix(n = n, mu = c(1, 2), 
                          sigmas = list(s1), skew = c(2, 1))

skew_draws_pos <- map_dfr(.x = 1:n, .f = pull_draw, 
                          data = mix_unif_skew)

skew_draws_pos |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = val), color = "black", fill = "lightpink") +
  facet_wrap(~pos, nrow = 2) +
  labs(x = "Value", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
mix_skewt <- rtskewt(n = 1e3, mu = c(1, 2), 
                     sigmas = list(s1), skew = c(2, 1),
                     nu = 20)

skewt_draws_pos <- map_dfr(.x = 1:n, .f = pull_draw, 
                          data = mix_skewt)

skewt_draws_pos |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = val), color = "black", fill = "lightpink") +
  facet_wrap(~pos, nrow = 2) +
  labs(x = "Value", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)

mu <- matrix(c(0, 0), nrow = 2, ncol = 1)

sigmas <- list(
  matrix(c(1, 0.5,
           0.5, 1), nrow = 2))

grid <- expand_grid(
  x11 = seq(-4, 4, length.out = 150),
  x21 = seq(-4, 4, length.out = 150)
) |>
  mutate(
    dens = purrr::map2_dbl(x11, x21, function(a, b) {
      x <- matrix(c(a, b), nrow = 2, ncol = 1)
      dtnorm(x, mu = mu, sigmas = sigmas, log = FALSE)
    })
  )

ggplot(grid, aes(x = x11, y = x21, z = dens)) +
  geom_contour_filled(bins = 20) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(
    x = "X[1, 1]",
    y = "X[2, 1]",
    fill = "density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(grid, aes(x = x11, y = x21, fill = dens)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(x = "X[1, 1]",
       y = "X[2, 1]", 
       fill = "density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
